body:
A friend and I rolled a joint (double wide) containing 3/4's pot and 1/4 mushroom shake from our bag.  We went out and smoked it, and got a regular high.  Maybe a little more intense, but nothing that couldn't simply have been attributed to different marijuana.  However, the length of the high seemed to be doubled, perhaps even 2.5x as long as usual.  My friend and I were extremely high for almost 2 hours, which is very unusual for us.  We did not return to baseline for almost 6 hours.  All in all, a very unusual session, with some effects that I really have no choice but to attrubute to the mushrooms.  Granted, much of it could have been the placebo effect, but I'm just putting my experience out there.
